description: Use this skill for any request involving cryptocurrency market data, coin prices, trading volume, market cap, OHLC charts, historical data, exchanges, derivatives, NFTs, DeFi, on-chain token data, liquidity pools, DEX data, or anything powered by CoinGecko or GeckoTerminal APIs. Trigger this skill whenever the user asks about crypto prices, token data, market trends, or wants to call any CoinGecko or GeckoTerminal endpoint — even if they don't explicitly say "CoinGecko". Also trigger when the user asks about API keys, rate limits, or authentication for these APIs.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
